invariants.statement: Runtime types and shapes are never trusted from annotations, constructors, SDK models or caller intent; every externally reachable boundary validates before type-dependent operations.
Every public or indirectly callable entry point that can emit governed data must enforce the same structural and semantic policy as the canonical safe path.
Untrusted or optional metadata must be cheaply size-bounded before allocation, encoding, hashing, HMAC, parsing, iteration, or any other work proportional to attacker-controlled input length.
Observability and other optional diagnostic context cannot own business liveness, authorization, identity, idempotency, ordering or delivery semantics.
Observable and exported context is deny-by-default, bounded, classified and redacted, and cannot expose protected or globally correlatable cross-tenant state.
Representation, formatting, equality, prefixes, object type, origin or successful parsing never constitute authority or provenance by themselves.
A proof or attestation cannot be issued independently of the protected transformation or validation it claims occurred.

Proofs bind semantic identity rather than incidental serialization unless a representation component is explicitly governed; when an authenticated representation companion is used to make a transformation idempotent, that companion must itself be authenticated and must distinguish already-governed representation from newly introduced raw representation.
Tenant isolation holds at the raw observable/exported representation, not only inside application helper predicates or query filters.
Evidence identity, source lineage, authority snapshots and canonical representations are validated as complete exact envelopes; partial equality is insufficient.

Every material review surface and supported reconciliation trigger must feed the same strict reconciliation gate for the exact current pull-request head, and stale or superseded reconciliation runs must never be able to overwrite a newer failing result with success.

A learning-ledger guardrail is creditable only when its declared identifier resolves to a check that is actually reachable from the real CI entrypoint and performs a direct registered negative test; raw textual occurrence, generic assertions, statically dead branches, calls after unconditional termination, or no-op falsifier bodies are never evidence.

Assurance code controlled by a pull request must never execute, source, or share mutable runner state with a job that receives write authority; write permissions are isolated to trusted publication jobs, and mutation commands are semantically parsed and restricted to exact allowlisted methods and endpoints.
